Verify the post-condition holds: 'After an exception is raised during block processing, all partial state changes must be rolled back to the pre-operation snapshot. The error must be propagated to the caller without leaving partial state modifications.'. 3. Check for unexpected side-effects (modified global state, leaked resources). 4. Test under failure conditions (disk full, network error, timeout). 5. Verify idempotency if the operation is retried.
executable_checks: Execute operation and verify: After an exception is raised during block processing, all partial state changes must be rolled back
